Prototype methodology

These gauges use illustrative thresholds to demonstrate the dashboard. Replace them with your own system's rules before launch.

  • Trend Regime — SPY vs its 50- and 200-day moving averages. Bullish above both, bearish below both, neutral when mixed.
  • Momentum — 63-trading-day S&P 500 return. Bullish above +5%, bearish below −5%.
  • Realized Volatility — 20-day annualized standard deviation of SPY returns. Bullish under 14%, bearish over 22%.
  • Yield Curve — 10-year minus 2-year Treasury yield (FRED). Bullish over +0.25pp, bearish under −0.25pp.
  • Inflation — CPI year-over-year (FRED). Bullish under 2.5%, bearish over 3.5%.
  • Labor — Unemployment rate and 3-month change (FRED). Bearish if up 0.3pp or more in 3 months.

Sources: Massive (price history), FRED (macro series). Computed at build time; refresh with npm run signals.
